# CANDIDATE: VOL_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of ATR contraction, a breakout on above-average volume tends to capture the next impulsive move. This edge exists because low volatility often precedes volatility expansion, and volume confirmation helps filter false breakouts in ranging markets.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter long when all conditions are met 5-bar: 10-bar ATR is at its lowest value of the prior 50 bars (ATR contraction).
-: Price breaks above the highest high of the prior 20 bars (breakout).
-: Volume > 2× the 20-bar average volume (volume confirmation).
-: Breakout bar is bullish (close > open).

**Exit:** 
-: Initial stop: chart-stop at the low of the breakout bar.
-: TP1: at 2× ATR (measured at entry) added to entry price.
-: Runner trail: chandelier exit (ATR×3) trailing from the high-water mark (highest high since entry).
